notes.title: FPS drop fix
notes.notes:
Hello!

I got some messages that Ringo has FPS drop now and I investigated this issue. This happened due to latest Windows updates, and since I don't update Windows I didn't notice it.

I fixed it for Ringo and for Arrest as well. Now it should be fine.

notes.title: EASY MODE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35742349/05b4e40321683fbde60e8905f113ffeb6e8478f0.png[/img]

I was struggling about proper difficulty before releasing the game, as initially I played it even in GOD mode and it was fun, but then I chose more hardcore approach and it was fun for me too. So I didn't knew what to choose but decided that a challenging gameplay will be more interesting for players. But perhaps I was wrong.

So here's the EASY MODE which you can set for the game at the very beginning. I hope it will help some players to enjoy the game.

notes.title: Translations at the release

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35742349/e2552d250eb2b1e4d013d2752d14ea9be4bc9fa6.png[/img]

I hope that the game will launch with these languages available:

[list]
